"6.

(2011) 1 SCC 343
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The heads under which compensation is awarded in personal injury cases are the following:
Pecuniary damages (Special damages)
(i) Expenses relating to treatment, hospitalisation, medicines, transportation,
nourishing food, and miscellaneous expenditure.
(ii) Loss of earnings (and other gains) which the injured would have made had he not been injured, comprising:
(a) Loss of earning during the period of treatment;
(b) Loss of future earnings on account of permanent disability.
(iii) Future medical expenses.
Nonpecuniary damages (General damages)
(iv) Damages for pain, suffering and trauma as a consequence of the injuries.
MACT No. 528/2022 Krishna Deo Jha Vs. Radha Kishan & Ors.

entities.text: Krishna Deo Jha Vs. Radha Kishan & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Page No. 5 of 18 (v) Loss of amenities (and/or loss of prospects of marriage).
(vi) Loss of expectation of life (shortening of normal longevity).

In routine personal injury cases, compensation will be awarded only under heads (i), (ii) (a) and (iv).
It is only in serious cases of injury, where there is specific medical evidence corroborating the evidence of the claimant, that compensation will be granted under any of the heads (ii)(b), (iii), (v) and (vi) relating to loss of future earnings on account of permanent disability, future medical expenses, loss of amenities (and/or loss of prospects of marriage) and loss of expectation of life."

In the present claim petition, the MLC of the petitioner from RTRM Hospital is of simple injury.
However, the petitioner , in his evidence by way of affidavit, has claimed that he suffered grievous injuries in the accident.
He has also produced treatment record of Yatharth Super Specialty Hospital which shows that he suffered grievous injury and remained admitted in the said hospital from 10.11.2021 to 13.11.2021.
The petitioner was cross examined on the aspect of nature of injuries suffered by him in the accident and the relevant portion of his deposition is extracted below:
"....After giving first aid at RTRM Hospital, I was discharged from the hospital.
I have sustained injuries on left side of my face.
No CT scan or MRI of my face was done at RTRM.

I was feeling pain, so after two three days I again went to Yatharth Hospital at Noida, where CT scan and MRI of my face was done and the report reveals that multiple fractures over the left side of my face for which I have also undergone plastic surgery.
I remained hospitalized for a period of 34 days.
All the medical expenses were borne by me only...."

17. In view of the discharge summary, cash final bill, and other medical documents of the petitioner from Yatharth Super Speciality Hospital and the the explanation provided by him in his cross-examination, this Tribunal is convinced that the petitioner suffered grievous injuries in the accident.
